messages.subject: Time varying coefficient model
parts:
Hi INLA friends:

I am doing a spatial-temporal study, the random effect is fine. But for my fix effect part (predictors),  I want the coefficient in each time point since I believe the coefficient is not constant over time. 

I don't find any related paper doing the same thing, can I use INLA get this?

Longwen Zhao
Thanks

becomes
